Hey CBIT Hyderabad final years, if you still don't have a solid AI project on your resume for placements, NxtWave is hosting a free 60-minute hands-on workshop this weekend. We'll build and deploy a working AI agent live from scratch. Zero fluff, fully verified certificate. Claim your spot before seats fill:
http://localhost:3000 🚀
